title: Quiet Hours by the Window
summary: A ginger cat, a warm cup of tea, and a mountain lake glowing in the last light of day.
description:
Take a quiet moment by the window. A ginger cat rests beside a cup of tea as apricot sunlight settles over a mountain lake, distant villages, and lavender peaks. Trailing greenery and soft painted textures bring a little warmth to your screen.
